title: Yes/No questions and short answers with be
description: Are you …? – Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. – Fragen mit be und Kurzantworten
subject: Englisch

categories.name: Frage bilden
categories.description: Am I …? Is she …? Are they …? – Verb vor das Subjekt

categories.name: Kurzantwort mit yes
categories.description: Yes, I am. / Yes, she is. – immer Langform

categories.name: Kurzantwort mit no
categories.description: No, I'm not. / No, he isn't. / No, they aren't.

categories.name: Richtiges Pronomen
categories.description: Is your mum …? → she · Are you …? → I / we

questions.explanation: Lena = she → is. In der Frage steht is vor dem Subjekt.
your parents = they → are.
Ja/Nein-Frage mit be: Verb zuerst, dann Subjekt – Is Noah …?
Zu I gehört immer am: Am I …?

questions.prompt: ___ you and Ben in the football team?
questions.explanation: you and Ben = ihr → are.
the dog = it → is.

questions.prompt: Make a question: Ms Carter is our new teacher. → ___ our new teacher?
questions.explanation: Verb vor das Subjekt: Is Ms Carter …?

questions.prompt: Make a question: They are from Munich. → ___ from Munich?
questions.explanation: Aus They are wird in der Frage Are they …?

questions.text: {Is} your bike new? {Are} the twins at school? {Am} I in your group? {Is} it cold outside?
{Are} you ten? {Is} Mia your sister? {Are} we in Room 5? {Am} I right?

questions.explanation: Positive Kurzantwort immer mit Langform: Yes, I am. Nie: Yes, I'm.
Yes-Kurzantwort: keine Kurzform am Ende – Yes, she is.
Yes, they're ist falsch – bei yes immer die Langform.
Ben = he; positive Kurzantwort mit Langform: he is.
the film = it → Yes, it is. (nicht: it's)

questions.prompt: Are Lena and Tom friends? – Yes, ___.
questions.explanation: Lena and Tom = they → Yes, they are.

questions.prompt: Am I in your team? – Yes, ___.
questions.explanation: Fragt jemand Am I …?, antwortest du mit you: Yes, you are.

questions.text: Is your cat black? – Yes, it {is}. Are you twelve? – Yes, I {am}. Are we late? – Yes, we {are}.
Is Ms Carter nice? – Yes, {she is}. Is the pizza hot? – Yes, {it is}.

questions.explanation: Es gibt kein amn't. Richtig: No, I'm not.

questions.prompt: Are the boys in the park? – No, ___.
questions.explanation: they → aren't (are not).
he → isn't (is not).

questions.prompt: Is your room big? – No, ___. (Kurzform mit n't)
questions.explanation: the room = it → No, it isn't.

questions.prompt: Is Lena at the swimming pool? – No, ___. (Kurzform mit n't)
questions.explanation: Lena = she → No, she isn't.

questions.prompt: Are your pens in your bag? – No, ___. (Kurzform mit n't)
questions.explanation: your pens = they → aren't, nicht isn't.

questions.prompt: Am I late? – No, ___. (Kurzform mit n't)
questions.explanation: Am I …? → Antwort mit you: No, you aren't.

questions.text: Is it Monday? – No, it {isn't}. Are your friends here? – No, they {aren't}. Are you sad? – No, I'm {not}.
Is Ben in Year 6? – No, he {isn't}. Are we in the same group? – No, we {aren't}. Are you cold? – No, I'm {not}.

questions.prompt: Are you in Year 5, Mia? – Yes, ___.
questions.explanation: Frage an eine Person mit you → Antwort mit I.

questions.prompt: Are you and Noah brothers? – Yes, ___.
questions.explanation: you = ihr (mehrere) → Antwort mit we.

questions.prompt: Is your mum a doctor? – No, ___.
questions.explanation: your mum = she.

questions.prompt: Is your grandpa from Munich? – Yes, ___.
questions.explanation: your grandpa = he → Yes, he is.
you two = ihr beide → Antwort mit we.

questions.prompt: Is your new phone expensive? – No, ___. (Kurzform mit n't)
questions.explanation: Dinge = it → No, it isn't.

questions.text: Is your aunt nice? – Yes, {she} is. Are the books new? – No, {they} aren't. Is your school big? – Yes, {it} is.
Are you ready, Ben? – Yes, {I} am. Are you and Lena ready? – Yes, {we} are. Is Mr Weber here? – No, {he} isn't.
Is your dad at work? – Yes, he {is}. Is the shop open? – No, it {isn't}.

questions.prompt: Are you from Berlin, Noah? – No, ___. (Kurzform)
questions.explanation: Mit I gibt es nur I'm not – nicht I amn't.
